lyrics.text: In the late-night hours I find my way
Through the vinyl static the needle sways
Every groove a memory carved in black
A dying art that keeps pulling me back
Spin it round let the music play
Dust and gold on a smoky stage
Midnight soul in an amber haze
A dying art and it's here to stay
Crackle hiss as the platter spins
Every record a world that begins
Analog warmth that the digital lacks
A dying art and it never looks back
